ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The problem statement gives that in triangle ABC, a=1, ∠A=π/6, and ∠B=π/4. According to triangle side-length notation, a=BC, which is the opposite side of ∠A; the required side is understood according to the method draft as side c=AB, that is, the opposite side of ∠C. First, from the sum of interior angles of a triangle, obtain ∠C=π-π/6-π/4=7π/12. Then use the sine theorem c/sin C=a/sin A, so c=a·sin C/sin A=1·sin(7π/12)/sin(π/6). Because sin(π/6)=1/2, c=2sin(7π/12). Calculate sin(7π/12)=sin(π/3+π/4)=sin(π/3)cos(π/4)+cos(π/3)sin(π/4)=√3/2·√2/2+1/2·√2/2=(√6+√2)/4. Therefore c=2·(√6+√2)/4=(√6+√2)/2.

method.method_draft: 先从题干读取三角形中边长记号：a=BC=1，∠A=π/6，∠B=π/4，要求的是边 c=AB。用三角形内角和求 ∠C=π-π/6-π/4=7π/12。再用正弦定理 c/sin C=a/sin A，得到 c=sin(7π/12)/sin(π/6)=2sin(7π/12)。最后用 sin(7π/12)=sin(π/3+π/4)=(√6+√2)/4，得 c=(√6+√2)/2。

method.method_draft: 从题干读取 a=BC=1，∠A=30°，∠B=45°，要求 c=AB。作 CD⊥AB，垂足为 D。由于 ∠B=45° 且 BC=1，直角三角形 BCD 是 45°-45°-90° 三角形，所以 BD=CD=1/√2=√2/2。再看直角三角形 ACD，∠A=30°，tan30°=CD/AD，因此 AD=CD/tan30°=(√2/2)·√3=√6/2。于是 c=AB=AD+BD=√6/2+√2/2=(√6+√2)/2。
method.CoT_raw: 从题干读取：在△ABC中，按常用记号 a=BC=1，∠A=π/6=30°，∠B=π/4=45°，要求边 c=AB。作 CD⊥AB，垂足为 D。因为 D 在 AB 上，所以∠CBD=∠ABC=45°；又 BC=1，直角三角形 BCD 是 45°-45°-90°三角形，因此 BD=CD=BC/√2=1/√2=√2/2。再看直角三角形 ACD，∠CAD=∠A=30°，tan30°=CD/AD，所以 AD=CD/tan30°=(√2/2)/(1/√3)=√6/2。于是 c=AB=AD+BD=√6/2+√2/2=(√6+√2)/2。
